lessons_used: Moving sign-in after pet adoption was helpful and underpredicted (+13.3% vs +12.0%), but moving it to hand-off showed no clear effect and moving it after the waiting room made results worse (-3.9%). Account sync sign-in banners were also helpful (+2.7%).
Path clarity headline copy updates were helpful and underpredicted (+5.9% vs +1.0%), whereas general path copy simplification and time expectation banners showed no clear effect.
Interactive waiting rooms (+5.6%) and photo quality incentives (+7.6%) were helpful, though their predicted impacts (+8.0% and +10.0%) were too high.
Compact grid layouts for friend selection in pet adoption performed worse (-7.7%).
Progress trackers, sound notifications, split photo upload assistants, mascot welcome stages, and desktop spawn alerts showed no clear effect.

lessons_next: Moving sign-in post-adoption or post-certificate sequence was helpful (underpredicted in round 1 at +13.3% vs +12.0%), and account sync banners were helpful (+2.7%), but moving sign-in after the waiting room made results worse (-3.9%) and hand-off timing showed no clear effect.

Path clarity headline updates were helpful and underpredicted (+5.9% vs +1.0%), whereas general path copy simplification, value proposition refreshes, and time expectation banners showed no clear effect.

Interactive waiting rooms (+5.6%) and background hatching readiness status (+3.3%, underpredicted) were helpful, though interactive waiting room impact was overpredicted (+8.0% vs +5.6%); 3D progress trackers showed no clear effect.

Photo quality guides and companion previews were helpful (+7.6%, overpredicted at +10.0%), while compact friend selection grid layouts made results worse (-7.7%) and split photo upload assistants showed no clear effect.

System tray location notification tips were helpful (+3.8%), but first interaction notification tips made results worse (-6.5%), and sound notifications, spawn alerts, and mascot welcome stages showed no clear effect.
